summary: The diff implements most of the requested requirements. REQ-1 (banner replacement) is implemented with new grocery-themed banners. REQ-2 (ShopStatusToggle rewrite with backend persistence and UI restrictions) is implemented. REQ-3 (Admin dark/blue redesign with stat cards) is implemented. REQ-4 (delivery badge and fee logic) is implemented. However, there are some gaps: the 'Active Users' stat card uses phone number deduplication instead of distinct users with orders from the backend, and the required banner image files themselves are not added in the diff. The third banner still references 'hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png' which may be vegetable/sabji themed.

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove any vegetable or sabji imagery from the homepage entirely
missing_requirements.reason: HeroBannerCarousel still includes a third banner referencing '/assets/generated/hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png'. If the existing hero-banner image is vegetable/sabji themed, it violates this requirement. Additionally, the two new banner image files (grocery-banner-rice-oil.dim_1200x400.png and grocery-banner-biscuits-snacks.dim_1200x400.png) are not listed as added files in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Each stat card displays a live value fetched from the backend for Active Users showing distinct users with orders
missing_requirements.reason: The AdminPage computes uniqueCustomers using frontend phone number deduplication on the already-fetched orders array rather than fetching a dedicated distinct user count from the backend.

hallucinated_features.description: Batch routing feature in AdminPage that groups active orders by delivery address
hallucinated_features.reason: The diff includes a batch order filter and batchGroups logic grouping orders by delivery address. This feature was not requested in the build request.

hallucinated_features.description: CheckoutPage renders a full blocked UI page when shop is closed instead of just relying on CartDrawer navigation block
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only requires CartDrawer to block checkout navigation when shop is closed. The CheckoutPage additionally renders a complete blocked state UI, which goes beyond the stated requirements.
